arabic: مِنَ العَقَبَةِ إِلى شَرْمِ الشَّيْخِ بِالقارِبِ
english: From Aqaba to Sharm el-Sheikh by boat
We will meet in Sharm el-Sheikh

arabic: سَأَكونُ في شَرْمِ الشَّيْخِ يَوْمَيْنِ فَقَطْ
english: I will be in Sharm el-Sheikh for only two days
After that I will go to Dahab

arabic: أُريدُ أَنْ أَتَجَوَّلَ حَوْلَ المَدينَةِ القَديمَةِ
english: I want to wander around the old city
I want to discover the culture
We will swim in front of the hotel
Diving is not suitable for children
We will do it God willing
This is my first visit to Egypt
This is my first time in Egypt
I want to see this food
I want to practise the Egyptian dialect

arabic: أَتَمَنّى أَنْ تَسْتَعْمِلَ هَذِهِ الكَلِماتِ في الزِّيارَةِ
english: I hope you use these words on the visit
I wish you a happy holiday
Where is the hotel's private beach?
